t2i_prompt: Contact page mockup on a deep navy background with faint blueprint construction grid lines and a double-rule title block at the top. Three stacked route cards with file-folder tabs labelled Route 1, 2, 3: warm cream cards, the middle one inverted to navy with a steel-blue headline and a wide call bar. Each card holds a short form or action and ends with a 1-2-3 step strip of circled numerals and arrows: <CONTENT>. A dotted connector runs down the left margin linking the routes. Bottom right: hatched line map with a star pin. Monospaced type, flat, square corners.
signature_idea: Contact as three filed routes by situation, each showing exactly what happens next in three numbered steps.
strengths: routes by buyer situation, not by department
next-step strips set expectations and response times
urgent route clearly differentiated by inversion
folder tab metaphor fits engineering paperwork
weaknesses: busy grid background competes with cards
map adds weight without much decision value
slightly rounded card corners and many borders
brand_fit_why: Navy/limestone with a steel-blue accent and calm stepped structure fit; monospace everywhere instead of Geist light headlines and a busy grid ground reduce fit.
